## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
Sector Rotation, not Risk-Off. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -5.80% | 1M: -0.09%) while XLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.28% | 1M: +7.37%); VXX in RECOVERY (1W: +1.73% | 1M: -20.09%) ↑ rising and HYG/LQD in CORRECTION (HYG 1W: -0.20% | 1M: +1.03%; LQD 1W: -0.37% | 1M: +0.43%) confirm mixed signals.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Credit stress rising: Credit Spread 0.7295 (1W: +0.17% | 1M: +0.60%) ABOVE TREND with HYG/LQD in CORRECTION — HYG/LQD showing near‑term weakness. Fear showing a short‑term pop: VXX RECOVERY (1W: +1.73% | 1M: -20.09%) ↑ rising (potential reversal); SPY/TLT ↓ falling (1W: -2.15% | 1M: +2.81%) signals risk‑on exhaustion.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Neutral to tightening: TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -0.44% | 1M: -1.06%) and SPY CORRECTION (1W: -2.58% | 1M: +1.71%) with credit spreads firming — financial conditions modestly restrictive.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Cyclicals showing relative strength while Tech lags: XLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.28% | 1M: +7.37%), XLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.16% | 1M: +5.68%); XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -5.80% | 1M: -0.09%). Style mixed / no clear leadership given narrow breadth.

5. US vs Global?  
US moderating: SPY CORRECTION (1W: -2.58% | 1M: +1.71%); Europe mixed but resilient: VGK CORRECTION (1W: -0.76% | 1M: +4.17%) and Europe vs US ABOVE TREND. EM/China weak: EEM BELOW TREND (1W: -2.78% | 1M: -1.27%), FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -3.16%).

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Speculation cooling: IBIT BELOW TREND (1W: -6.51% | 1M: -7.50%), ARKK CORRECTION (1W: -5.31% | 1M: +3.64%), IWM CORRECTION (1W: -3.77% | 1M: +6.25%) — risk‑taking is selective and vulnerable to volatility.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Precious metals leading: SLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.58% | 1M: +30.72%), GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.54% | 1M: +6.66%). Industrial metals in CORRECTION: CPER CORRECTION (1W: -1.13% | 1M: +7.89%).

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy under pressure: XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -2.57% | 1M: -1.65%), BNO BELOW TREND (1W: -3.53% | 1M: -4.84%), and UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -3.36% | 1M: -11.11%) — demand/inventory narrative weighing on the group.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
Confirmed: Precious metals (GLD ABOVE TREND; SLV ABOVE TREND) and select cyclicals (XLY/XLB above both frames). Major divergence: SPY, QQQ, IWM and multiple sectors show 1W down vs 1M up (MAJOR DIVERGENCE) — suppress strong regime convictions.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor selective cyclicals and commodity/gold exposure (XLY, XLB, GLD, SLV) and reduce exposure to stretched tech (XLK) and crypto risk (IBIT); maintain neutral duration posture via TLT monitoring.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: Consumer Discretionary XLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.28% | 1M: +7.37%) — watch continuation. BEARISH: Technology XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -5.80% | 1M: -0.09%) — watch downside pressure.

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: Silver SLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.58% | 1M: +30.72%) — monitor flows. BEARISH: Natural gas UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -3.36% | 1M: -11.11%) and oil BNO BELOW TREND (1W: -3.53% | 1M: -4.84%) — watch seasonal weakness.

13. Key Levels?  
VXX ~20 (complacency/alert), HYG/LQD ratio ~0.80 (credit health pivot), XLK/XLF ratio move of ~2.0 (growth vs value rotation), SPY support at the recent 1W lows (monitor for follow‑through).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

Rotation, not outright Risk‑Off; Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Cyclicals and precious metals showing relative strength (XLY ABOVE TREND; GLD/SLV ABOVE TREND). Key risk: major 1W vs 1M divergences across SPY/QQQ/IWM and a VXX short‑term bounce — monitor for spillover into tech (XLK BELOW TREND).
